title: Data Science Analyst
description: JOB DESCRIPTION At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts. Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet. Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all. # About the team and the role **The Consumer-to-Consumer (C2C) team** focuses on making selling on eBay simple, fast, and rewarding for everyday sellers, from listing and shipping to getting paid and selling again. C2C is a key growth engine for eBay: it brings unique inventory to the marketplace, and sellers who also buy drive significantly more demand across the platform. The team works to grow and retain the C2C seller base, improve selling velocity, and strengthen this buyer–seller flywheel. **In this role** in the Indian Analytics Centre, you will be a hands-on analytics partner for C2C product initiatives. You will take well-scoped and moderately ambiguous product questions, break them down into clear analyses, and turn your findings into crisp insights and recommendations. Working closely with senior analysts and the analytics manager, you will build strong product and data depth in C2C and grow towards independently owning larger problem spaces. The role suits someone who is curious, self-driven, and eager to take ownership of their work. # What you will accomplish Own analytics for defined C2C workstreams Measure how C2C product changes move core outcomes such as seller growth, listings, sold items, and incremental GMV, and help identify the levers that make C2C sellers more successful. Break down product and business questions into structured analyses with clear hypotheses and success metrics, with guidance on scoping for broader or more ambiguous problems. Use strong SQL and analytical rigour to analyse customer behaviour, product performance, feature adoption, funnels, and cohorts across large datasets. Turn analysis into clear, well-structured insights and recommendations for product managers and working teams, and contribute to narratives shared with senior stakeholders. Partner with product, engineering, design, and peer analytics teams on day-to-day questions, and keep stakeholders informed on progress, findings, and risks. Support measurement for product tests and launches, including defining metrics, building dashboards, monitoring performance, and diagnosing changes. Build and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and recurring reporting that enable consistent performance tracking and self-service. Look beyond the immediate ask, flag anomalies, emerging trends, and opportunities in the data, and bring them to the team with a point of view. Maintain high analytical quality by following clear metric definitions, validating data, documenting assumptions, and having work reviewed before it is shared. # What you will bring ## Required qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent practical experience) in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or another quantitative field. 2–4 years of experience in analytics, data science, or a related role, ideally in a product or consumer technology setting. Strong hands-on SQL skills and experience analysing large, imperfect datasets with accuracy and attention to detail. Experience in product or business analytics, such as funnel analysis, customer journey analysis, feature adoption, segmentation, or performance measurement. Ability to build clear, user-friendly dashboards and data visualisations using BI or analytics tools. Understanding of A/B testing fundamentals and experiment measurement. Good critical thinking and problem-solving skills, including the ability to question assumptions and understand the real question behind an ask. Ability to communicate findings clearly in writing and verbally, and to present analysis confidently to product and cross-functional partners. Self-driven and proactive working style, with a strong sense of ownership and the willingness to ask questions, raise issues, and move work forward. Ability to manage multiple tasks while maintaining high standards for data quality and timely delivery. An AI-first mindset and interest in using AI-enabled tools to improve analytical productivity and synthesis. ## Good to have Working knowledge of Python for exploratory analysis, automation, or prototyping. Exposure to causal inference or quasi-experimental methods. Experience with product analytics platforms such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar tools. Experience in e-commerce, online marketplaces, seller or creator platforms, or consumer technology. Additional Details eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. title: Risk & Compliance Analyst
description: We are a fast-growing B2B fintech startup simplifying how businesses manage collections, payouts, and financial operations. As we continue to scale, we are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Risk & Compliance Executive to strengthen our risk framework and help safeguard our payments ecosystem. If you have a keen eye for identifying risks, enjoy investigative work, and are passionate about building a secure and compliant financial ecosystem, this is your opportunity to make an impact. Join us in building trust, strengthening controls, and shaping the future of secure digital payments! Key Responsibilities Business KYC & Business Onboarding Review and verify business onboarding documents for authenticity, accuracy, and regulatory completeness in accordance with applicable regulatory guidelines. Examine corporate incorporation records, constitutional documents, statutory registrations, tax-related records, and other supporting business documents. Cross-verify company details, registration status, ownership information, and business particulars through official government portals and authorised public databases. Validate the nature of business, ownership structure, registered address, website/application, business model, and intended use of financial services. Conduct enhanced due diligence (EDD) as part of every new business onboarding to assess business legitimacy and identify potential risk factors. Identify discrepancies, inconsistencies, or potential red flags and maintain proper verification records and audit trails. AML & Transaction Monitoring Monitor transactions to identify suspicious, unusual, or potentially fraudulent activities. Conduct AML assessments by analysing transaction patterns, frequency, volume, counterparties, and deviations from expected business activity. Perform risk-based assessments to identify unusual transaction behaviour, potential layering, fund circulation, and other suspicious patterns. Support AML screening, alert investigation, and business risk scoring, including identification of potential sanctions, adverse media, and other relevant risk indicators. Review and investigate transaction alerts, document findings, and determine whether activities require further scrutiny or escalation. Identify potential fraud patterns, unusual fund flows, and emerging financial crime risks. Escalate suspicious activities and potential compliance breaches in line with internal protocols and applicable regulatory requirements. Maintain proper records of AML assessments, investigation outcomes, and alert resolutions. Regulatory & Compliance Support Assist in applicable RBI, NPCI, UPI, and payment gateway compliance activities. Support policy execution relating to transaction monitoring, risk assessment, compliance reporting, and internal audits. Maintain evidence and documentation for compliance reviews, regulatory assessments, and banking partner due diligence. Reporting & Process Governance Prepare and maintain KYC trackers, risk registers, alert resolution logs, and compliance MIS. Contribute to strengthening internal risk frameworks and SOPs. Skills & Competencies Detailed understanding of Business KYC, business verification, and compliance processes. Familiarity with corporate documentation, statutory records, and government verification portals. Ability to analyse transaction behaviour and identify irregularities. Understanding of AML assessment, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity identification. Strong attention to detail and structured thinking. Good communication and stakeholder coordination. Comfortable working with compliance trackers, dashboards, and reports. Integrity and ability to handle confidential information responsibly. Must-Have Traits High discretion in handling sensitive information. Strong ownership and accountability. Ability to work with SOPs and tight deadlines. Compliance-first mindset. Qualification Bachelor's degree in any field (Finance/Commerce/Business is preferred but not mandatory). Experience 1–2 years in corporate KYC, business verification, risk monitoring, AML, compliance, or operations. Exposure to payments, fintech, banking, or financial services compliance is an added advantage. Who Will Excel Here Enjoys compliance, verification, and investigation work. Has an eye for spotting discrepancies and anomalies. Wants to grow in the Fintech Risk & Compliance space. Values structured processes, accountability, and ownership. Job Types: Full-time, Permanent Pay: ₹20,833.00 - ₹33,333.00 per month Benefits: Health insurance Paid sick time Paid time off Provident Fund Ability to commute/relocate: Bengaluru, Karnataka: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required) Education: Bachelor's (Required) Experience: Risk analysis: 1 year (Preferred) Risk management: 1 year (Preferred) Compliance management: 1 year (Preferred) AML/KYC: 1 year (Preferred) Work Location: In person

title: Senior Financial Data Analyst
description: At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. Skills and Competencies Strong understanding of fundamental finance, financial statements, and basic capital-markets concepts. Up to 1-2 years of relevant experience in credit analysis, financial data analysis, or structured finance is preferred. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and investigative skills, including the ability to identify data issues, perform basic root-cause analysis, and support data-quality improvements. Working knowledge of data-management and data-quality principles, with the ability to validate datasets and support analysis, reporting, and operational processes. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and strong proficiency across the Microsoft Office suite are required. Knowledge of SQL, Python, or Power BI is preferred. Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet established deadlines, and consistently deliver accurate, high-quality work,effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work productively across teams and stakeholders. Basic understanding of artificial intelligence concepts, with curiosity about using AI tools responsibly to improve processes and efficiency. Education Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Accounting, Technology, Management, or a related discipline. Responsibilities Manage and validate financial data that supports structured-finance ratings, research, and analytical workflows. Perform data-intake activities, including collecting, scrubbing, validating, and preparing financial data for use in ratings and research. Apply established data standards and methodologies to produce adjusted data, key indicators, ratios, charts, and graphs that support analytical processes. Review and interpret financial reports, official statements, and other issuer-related documents to capture relevant performance information. Partner with ratings and support analysts to understand data-capture requirements, required adjustments, and additional information needed for ratings and research. Investigate and resolve data-point, mapping, and validation issues; perform basic root-cause analysis and escalate complex matters when appropriate. Conduct quality-control checks to maintain accuracy, completeness, consistency, and adherence to documented processes. Create clear visual representations of findings through charts, graphs, reports, or dashboards. Contribute to process-improvement and innovation initiatives, including appropriate and responsible exploration of AI-enabled tools. Complete newsletters, database maintenance, administrative deliverables, and other ad hoc support activities with appropriate oversight. The team combines operational excellence, quality, and innovation to strengthen data processes and analytical workflows. As part of this global team, you will collaborate with colleagues across regions, gain exposure to a broad range of corporate & structured-finance asset classes and markets, and help build the reliable data foundation that supports informed analytical decision-making. Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact. Job Overview Cards & Wealth Analytics & AI Enablement Specialist (C11) Who We Are Within Citi’s Analytics & Information Management (AIM) group, you will do meaningful work from Day 1. Our collaborative, inclusive, and forward-looking culture empowers professionals to grow and make a tangible impact across one of the world’s leading financial institutions. The AIM Cards & Wealth organization acts as the strategic intelligence engine across our credit card portfolios and wealth management franchises. We power customer acquisition, card spend stimulation, portfolio deepening, and wealth advisory insights. We actively integrate modern data architectures, customer analytics, and Generative AI productivity frameworks into our day-to-day operations to deliver hyper-relevant business insights, actionable customer intelligence, and optimized strategies for our cardholders and affluent wealth clients. What the Role Is We are hiring a Cards & Wealth Analytics & AI Enablement Specialist (C11) to join our Cards & Wealth Analytics, Insights & Optimization team. In this role, you will be the analytical owner and insight lead across Credit Card products (Acquisition, Spend Stimulation, Revolving, Balance Transfer, Loyalty/Rewards) and Wealth Management offerings (Investment Products, Wealth Advisory, Mortgages, FX, Time Deposits, and Digital Banking). You will combine core data extraction, customer analytics, experimentation, and portfolio optimization with applied AI enablement —leveraging modern GenAI tools, prompt and context engineering, knowledge base setup, retrieval optimization, Text-to-SQL assistants, and NLP to uncover high-impact growth opportunities, evaluate business performance, and accelerate analytical workflows. As a C11-level specialist, you will bridge the gap between business stakeholders and data platforms, maintaining rigorous data governance while championing AI-assisted productivity and analytical optimization within the team. Who You Are AI-Augmented Data Practitioner: You actively leverage modern GenAI tools, conversational assistants, context engineering, and prompt design to supercharge analytics, code generation, and business insights. Cards & Wealth Analytical Problem Solver: You excel at translating complex business questions into high-performance queries using SQL, PySpark, and Python , analyzing spend patterns, portfolio balances, and customer lifecycle journeys to maximize business ROI. Experimentation & Optimization Champion: You apply structured analytical techniques—such as customer funnel diagnostics, test-versus-control lift analysis, and cohort evaluation—to uncover performance drivers across card products and wealth tiers. Workflow Innovator: You proactively automate repetitive processes—using AI for Text-to-SQL generation, automated insight summarization, knowledge base curation, and communication variant ideation. Disciplined & Version-Controlled: You manage analytical assets, queries, and automation scripts using Git / GitHub for robust code collaboration and version control. Process & Controls Oriented: You uphold strict data quality standards, customer privacy regulations, and risk/compliance controls across all analytical deliverables. What You Do (Core Responsibilities) 1. Data Extraction & Analytical Pipeline Management Partner with Cards and Wealth Product Managers, Marketing, and Segment teams to translate business priorities and strategy objectives into robust technical logic. Develop, test, and execute data extraction queries and analytical pipelines using SQL, PySpark, and Python to generate high-quality analytical datasets and customer segment pools across big data environments. 2. Cards & Wealth Analytics, Experimentation & Optimization Portfolio & Customer Funnel Analytics: Analyze customer lifecycle funnels (Acquisition ➔ Activation ➔ Spend/Investment Engagement ➔ Balance/NNA Deepening ➔ Retention) across Card and Wealth portfolios to diagnose drop-offs and identify revenue-generating opportunities. Experimentation & Lift Measurement: Design and execute test-versus-control experimental frameworks and A/B test splits to isolate incremental product conversion, spend lift, revolving behavior, and Net New Assets (NNA). Spend, Balance & Channel Optimization: Analyze transactional patterns, merchant categories, revolving balances, and channel touchpoints (Mobile App, Online Banking, Direct, RM outreach) to recommend strategy refinements and targeting optimization. Interactive Visualizations: Build and maintain interactive performance tracking dashboards and diagnostic tools in Tableau / Power BI with automated underlying data aggregation feeds. 3. GenAI Enablement, Context Engineering & Workflow Automation Context Engineering & Knowledge Base Setup: Organize, structure, and curate internal analytics rules, data dictionaries, card/wealth product taxonomies, and strategy playbooks into searchable knowledge bases to enable high-accuracy AI retrieval and team knowledge sharing.
